briefdescription.para: 8x8 glyph bitmaps indexed by ASCII value.

detaileddescription.para: Printable ASCII (indices 32..126) uses a bold style; S, R, and A retain their existing display-specific designs. Glyph rows run top to bottom, with bit 7 as the leftmost pixel. Index 127 is blank.
Copy one glyph into the framebuffer; call led_matrix_show() to display it.
Draw and immediately display one glyph.
Display a string one character at a time, waiting wait_ms after each glyph.
Slide a string from right to left one pixel column at a time.

Reveal each character row by row, pulsing at intensity 15 for 40 ms and returning to the saved brightness for 70 ms after each row. Hold the character, then wipe it column by column. Wait character_delay_ms between characters and one second after the string. On failure, attempt to restore brightness and return the original error. Restoration failures are logged; the saved brightness is always preserved. Serialize access to the matrix while this blocking animation runs.
